_leia: Inglês dos módulos embutidos no painel (telas de sistema/physis-*.js) e dos textos novos do painel. Embutido por ferramentas/embutir_bases.py como base-i18n-modulos; o painel só acrescenta o que ainda não tem no próprio I18N.

I18N.Conforme: segue a norma ou o método de r: Compliant: follows the standard or the reference method. Simplified: follows the standard's approach with simpler assumptions. Only cited: the standard is mentioned, but the calculation does not apply it. Not yet implemented: the calculation does not yet follow what the standard or the law requires.
I18N.Validação preliminar: não substitui o pr: Preliminary validation: it does not replace a design with an ART (or RRT) by a licensed professional. Standards are cited only by number and item, in Physis's own wording; always consult the official current version.
I18N.Orçamento dos módulos escolhidos. Não há: Budget for the chosen modules. There is no engineering calculation.
I18N.Soma o preço de cada módulo escolhido, o: Adds up the price of each chosen module, the annual amount and the quantity.
I18N.total = Σ (quantidade × preço unitário);: total = Σ (quantity × unit price); annual = Σ annual amounts
I18N.preço da tabela da Physis: price from the Physis price list
I18N.Conta de soma; os preços vêm da tabela d: Simple sum; prices come from the Physis price list, never invented (placeholder when missing).
I18N.O preço e as condições aparecem claros a: The price and conditions are shown clearly before payment.
I18N.A página de pagamento mostra o preço tot: The payment page shows the total price, the charges and the conditions.
Applies to the price list in force.
Physis price list on the server.
I18N.Perfil do lugar e histórico das contas d: Site profile and history of electricity and water bills, which feed Carbon, Solar and Certifications.
I18N.Leva as últimas contas de luz (até 12) p: Scales the latest electricity bills (up to 12) to one year, to serve as reference consumption.
I18N.E_ano = (Σ kWh das últimas n contas) × 1: E_ano = (Σ kWh of the last n bills) × 12 ÷ n
I18N.Ideia de linha de base energética: um pe: Energy baseline idea: a reference period that represents normal use.
I18N.A média das contas é o começo da linha d: The average of the bills is the start of the baseline the standard requires.
I18N.Com menos de 12 contas a sazonalidade so: With fewer than 12 bills seasonality is lost; the system reports how many bills it used.
Bills entered by the person in Home.
I18N.Com 12 meses ou mais, normalizar pela va: With 12 months or more, normalize by the variable that explains consumption (degree-days, production, occupancy), as ISO 50006 requires. The consumption model in aprendizado.py already does part of this.
I18N.Terreno, implantação e cálculos por norm: Site, layout and standard-based calculations for the preliminary study (program modulos/planejador/planejador-physis.html).
I18N.Mede a inclinação do terreno em cada cél: Measures the terrain slope in each cell and marks areas above 45° as APP and above 30% as areas that require a study.
I18N.i = Δz ÷ Δx (m/m); APP se i ≥ 1 (45° = 1: i = Δz ÷ Δx (m/m); APP if i ≥ 1 (45° = 100%); warning if i ≥ 0,30
I18N.Encosta com mais de 45° é APP. O sistema: Slopes steeper than 45° are APP (permanent preservation area). The system uses 45° = 100% slope (degrees, not percent).
I18N.Terreno com 30% ou mais só pode ser parc: Land with 30% slope or more can only be subdivided under the authority's requirements; the system shows the warning.
I18N.Acima de 30% o sistema pede estudo de es: Above 30% the system requests a stability study.
I18N.A resolução é a do levantamento ou do mo: Resolution is that of the survey or the elevation model (30 m in SRTM). A 30 m model does not see small slopes.
I18N.Topografia enviada pela pessoa; sem ela,: Topography uploaded by the person; without it, an open elevation model (server, gis.py relevo).
I18N.Faltam as outras APP do art. 4º: faixas: The other APPs of art. 4º are missing: strips along rivers and streams (item I), around springs (item IV) and hilltops (item IX). Requires hydrography (IBGE/ANA) on the server.
I18N.Estima o fator de segurança (FS) da enco: Estimates the factor of safety (FS) of the slope when dry and saturated, to show where not to cut or infiltrate.
I18N.Talude infinito: FS = [c' + (γ·z − m·γw·: Infinite slope: FS = [c' + (γ·z − m·γw·z)·cos²β·tan φ'] ÷ (γ·z·sin β·cos β)
I18N.O FS mínimo de referência (1,5) é compar: The reference minimum FS (1,5) is compared with the calculated one; the standard requires a study with soil boring.
I18N.Os parâmetros são típicos até a sondagem: Parameters are typical values until the SPT boring.
I18N.Só triagem: talude infinito, parâmetros: Screening only: infinite slope, estimated parameters. Not valid for circular failure, rock or fill.
I18N.Parâmetros típicos por tipo de solo; son: Typical parameters by soil type; boring data when available.
I18N.Engenheiro geotécnico confere o FS mínim: A geotechnical engineer checks the minimum FS by the NBR 11682 safety level (lives and property at risk) and replaces it with an analysis based on borings.
I18N.Calcula a vazão de chuva antes e depois: Calculates rainfall runoff before and after construction and the volume needed so the peak does not increase.
I18N.Q = C·i·A ÷ 3,6 (método racional); i = K: Q = C·i·A ÷ 3,6 (rational method); i = K·T^a ÷ (t + b)^c; V_det ≈ (Q_depois − Q_antes)·t; SCS-CN as a second method
I18N.Citada para calhas e condutores; o dimen: Cited for gutters and downpipes; gutter sizing is not done yet.
I18N.Método racional e SCS-CN (TR-55) são mét: The rational method and SCS-CN (TR-55) are hydrology methods; municipal law usually requires detention.
I18N.Racional vale para bacias pequenas (até: The rational method applies to small basins (up to about 2 to 3 km²). The IDF curve must be the municipality's.
I18N.IDF informada pela pessoa (SGB/CPRM ou e: IDF entered by the person (SGB/CPRM or local study).
I18N.Dimensionar calha e condutor pela NBR 10: Size gutters and downpipes per NBR 10844: flow = intensity × contributing area ÷ 60 (L/min), with the return period and duration the standard specifies and the area corrected for roof pitch. A simple calculation that can be done now.
I18N.Estima o consumo diário pelas pessoas e: Estimates daily consumption by people and uses, storage, and whether pressure calls for a pressure-reducing valve.
I18N.Consumo = Σ (pessoas × L/pessoa·dia); re: Consumption = Σ (people × L/person·day); storage = consumption × days; reducing valve if height difference > 40 m
I18N.diferença de altura até o ponto mais bai: height difference down to the lowest point
I18N.Pressão estática acima de 400 kPa (≈ 40: Static pressure above 400 kPa (≈ 40 m) calls for a reducing valve; storage is set by the designer.
I18N.Os valores por pessoa saem da tabela de: Per-person values come from the sewage table, used as a consumption estimate.
I18N.Estimativa de estudo preliminar; não é o: Preliminary study estimate; it is not pipe sizing.
I18N.Reserva de 2 dias é premissa Physis (a N: 2 days of storage is a Physis assumption (NBR 5626 leaves it to the designer and the utility): add it to the assumptions base with a source. Pipe sizing (weights and flows) is left for the design.
I18N.Simula a cisterna dia a dia com a chuva: Simulates the cistern day by day with the project's monthly rainfall and shows coverage and days on mains water for several volumes.
I18N.Captado = P × A × C; balanço diário: S(d: Captured = P × A × C; daily balance: S(d) = min(S(d−1) + captured − demand, V)
I18N.A norma deixa escolher o método se ele f: The standard allows choosing the method if justified; the daily balance is one of the accepted ones.
I18N.A água de chuva vai só para usos não pot: Rainwater goes only to non-potable uses.
I18N.Chuva diária simulada a partir da mensal: Daily rainfall simulated from monthly data; valid as a study.
I18N.Chuva mensal do projeto (INMET ou base G: Project monthly rainfall (INMET or GIS base).
I18N.Descontar o volume de descarte inicial (: Subtract the first-flush volume (first rain) that NBR 15527 recommends; check the value in the standard.
I18N.Dimensiona o tanque séptico, o filtro an: Sizes the septic tank, anaerobic filter and infiltration area for houses without public sewer.
I18N.V_tanque = 1.000 + N·(C·T + K·Lf); V_fil: V_tanque = 1.000 + N·(C·T + K·Lf); V_filtro = 1,6·N·C·T; infiltration area = N·C ÷ infiltration coefficient
I18N.fórmula do volume útil e tabelas de C, T: useful volume formula and tables of C, T, K and Lf
I18N.Mesma forma de cálculo da norma; distânc: Same calculation form as the standard; minimum distances of 1,5 m checked on the map.
I18N.filtro anaeróbio, sumidouro e ensaio de: anaerobic filter, soakaway and percolation test (annex A)
I18N.Filtro e área de infiltração; a disposiç: Filter and infiltration area; final disposal depends on the test.
I18N.Pode ter substituído as duas acima: conf: It may have replaced the two above: check before using it in a design.
I18N.Ocupação informada; solo estimado até o: Occupancy entered; soil estimated until the percolation test.
I18N.Engenheiro confere se a NBR 17076:2024 s: An engineer checks whether NBR 17076:2024 replaced 7229 and 13969; if so, review formulas and tables.
I18N.Estima o consumo por área e uso e a potê: Estimates consumption by area and use and the solar power to cover 100%.
I18N.kWp = consumo mensal ÷ produção por kWp: kWp = monthly consumption ÷ production per kWp (kWh/kWp·month); panels = kWp ÷ 0,55
I18N.Citada para o projeto do arranjo; não ca: Cited for the array design; not calculated here.
I18N.Catálogo de consumo por área (editável);: Consumption catalog by area (editable); PVGIS or GIS base.
I18N.As normas são só citadas: o projeto elét: The standards are only cited: the electrical design of the array (strings, cables, protections) is left to the designer. See also the Solar energy module.
I18N.Dá a ordem de grandeza de pilares, vigas: Gives the order of magnitude of columns, beams, slabs and footings by tributary area.
I18N.Carga por pilar = área de influência × (: Load per column = tributary area × (self-weight + live load); footing = load ÷ allowable stress
Live load by type of use.
I18N.Só ordem de grandeza, malha de cerca de: Order of magnitude only, grid of about 5 m.
I18N.O cálculo estrutural é do projetista com: Structural design is done by the designer with an ART.
I18N.Mede o desnível do acesso até cada const: Measures the height difference from the access to each building and chooses sidewalk, ramp or platform lift.
I18N.inclinação = desnível ÷ distância; ≤ 5%: slope = height difference ÷ distance; ≤ 5% sidewalk; ≤ 8,33% ramp with landings; above that, platform lift
I18N.Limites de inclinação de calçada e rampa: Slope limits for sidewalks and ramps.
I18N.Rota pelo terreno, sem detalhar degraus,: Route across the site, without detailing steps, widths and landings.
I18N.A NBR 9050 limita também a altura de cad: NBR 9050 also limits the rise of each ramp segment according to its slope; include that table and the minimum width.
I18N.Indica extintores, iluminação, sinalizaç: Indicates extinguishers, lighting, signage and exits by use and area.
I18N.extintores ≥ área ÷ área por extintor (p: extinguishers ≥ area ÷ area per extinguisher (by risk class)
I18N.Indicativo; a exigência final é do Corpo: Indicative; the final requirement is set by the Fire Department.
Use and area of the buildings.
I18N.Ligar à Instrução Técnica do estado esco: Link to the Technical Instruction of the chosen state.
I18N.Calcula a exposição ao sol de telhados e: Calculates sun exposure of roofs and slopes and indicates the bioclimatic zone.
I18N.Posição do sol por latitude, dia e hora: Sun position by latitude, day and hour (declination and hour angle); shading from the terrain model
I18N.Zona bioclimática e diretrizes; só citad: Bioclimatic zone and guidelines; only cited.
I18N.Graus-dia e verificação da envoltória pe: Degree-days and envelope verification per NBR 15575 (transmittance and absorptance) are listed as the next module; an engineer checks the current revision of NBR 15220.
I18N.Modelagem rápida de energia, água, carbo: Quick modeling of energy, water, carbon and costs (sistema/SustainKit_Definitivo.html, SK object).
I18N.Estima a água de chuva captada por dia e: Estimates rainwater captured per day and people's consumption.
I18N.captação (L/dia) = chuva anual (mm) × ár: capture (L/day) = annual rainfall (mm) × area × C ÷ 365; consumption = people × L/person·day
I18N.Média anual serve só de estimativa; a no: The annual average is only an estimate; the standard asks to look at rainfall month by month.
I18N.Média do ano: esconde a seca. Não use pa: Annual average: it hides the dry season. Do not use it to set the cistern volume.
I18N.Usar a simulação mensal ou diária do Pla: Use the Planner's monthly or daily simulation (same NBR 15527 rule) and show the worst month.
I18N.Divide a água do dia em chuva, reúso, re: Splits the day's water into rain, reuse, mains, sewage and what does not return.
I18N.esgoto = 0,80 × demanda; reúso = min(esg: sewage = 0,80 × demand; reuse = min(sewage × %reuse, demand − rain); mains = demand − rain − reuse
I18N.Pôr o coeficiente de retorno na base de: Put the return coefficient in the assumptions base, with its source.
I18N.Potência mínima e geração anual pelas ho: Minimum power and annual generation from the city's peak sun hours.
I18N.P_min = consumo diário ÷ (HSP × PR); ger: P_min = daily consumption ÷ (HSP × PR); generation = P × HSP × 365 × PR
I18N.horas de sol pleno (média ou pior mês): peak sun hours (average or worst month)
I18N.O PR segue a definição da norma de monit: PR follows the definition in the monitoring standard.
I18N.Usar a mesma base de irradiação da aba E: Use the same irradiation base as the Solar energy tab (server) and the tilted plane.
I18N.Energia do banco para as horas de autono: Bank energy for the hours of autonomy.
I18N.Não há NBR de dimensionamento de banco d: There is no NBR for sizing battery banks; safety per IEC 62619 (lithium).
I18N.A aba Energia solar usa ÷ 0,95 (rendimen: The Solar energy tab uses ÷ 0,95 (efficiency) and SustainKit uses × 1,2 (margin): choose one rule and put it in the assumptions base.
I18N.Emissões da rede e do diesel, evitado pe: Emissions from the grid and diesel, avoided by solar and biogas, carbon from materials.
I18N.rede = kWh ÷ 1000 × fator SIN; diesel =: grid = kWh ÷ 1000 × SIN factor; diesel = kWh generated × 0,74; avoided biogas = m³ × 2,75 kgCO₂e
I18N.Fatores de diesel e biogás diferentes do: Diesel and biogas factors differ from those in the Carbon tab.
I18N.Unificar com a aba Carbono: diesel por l: Unify with the Carbon tab: diesel per liter (2,671 kgCO₂e/L from the base) and a single rule for biogas; avoided emissions outside the inventory (see Carbon).
I18N.Declinação, duração do dia e altura do s: Declination, day length and noon sun height by latitude and month.
Astronomy accurate enough for a study.
I18N.Conferir as zonas da tabela CIDADES com: Check the zones in the CIDADES table against the current revision of NBR 15220.
I18N.Energia diária das cargas do campo, potê: Daily energy of farm loads, solar power and battery.
I18N.kWh = Σ P·h ÷ 1000; P_min = kWh ÷ (HSP ×: kWh = Σ P·h ÷ 1000; P_min = kWh ÷ (HSP × 0,75); battery = kWh × 2 ÷ 0,80 × 1,2
I18N.Usa 0,75 em vez do PR da base (0,78) e D: Uses 0,75 instead of the base PR (0,78) and a fixed DoD of 0,80: link to the pv.pr and bateria.dod assumptions.
Total and share diverted from landfill.
I18N.desvio = Σ kg em rotas fora do aterro ÷: diversion = Σ kg on routes other than landfill ÷ Σ kg
I18N.Ordem de prioridade: não gerar, reduzir,: Order of priority: avoid, reduce, reuse, recycle, treat and only then dispose.
I18N.Materiais por zona e custo de acabamento: Materials by zone and finishing cost
I18N.Sugere materiais por zona bioclimática e: Suggests materials by bioclimatic zone and adds up the cost of finishes.
I18N.custo = (material + base) × área + ferra: cost = (material + base) × area + tools + labor × area
I18N.Desempenho de paredes e coberturas; só c: Performance of walls and roofs; only cited.
I18N.Custos de referência sem data nem fonte: Reference costs without date or price source.
I18N.Engenheiro confere se as sugestões por z: An engineer checks whether the suggestions by zone meet the NBR 15575 transmittance and absorptance limits; costs need a source and date.
I18N.Potencial do lugar, tamanho do sistema,: Site potential, system size, battery and savings (painel.html, solarCalc).
I18N.Irradiação média de cada mês: medida por: Average irradiation for each month: measured by satellite (NASA POWER, on the server) or estimated from latitude.
I18N.H = H0 × KT; H0 = (24 ÷ π)·Gsc·E·[cos φ·: H = H0 × KT; H0 = (24 ÷ π)·Gsc·E·[cos φ·cos δ·sin ωs + ωs·sin φ·sin δ]
I18N.irradiação diária no plano horizontal: daily irradiation on the horizontal plane
I18N.Fórmula usada quando a base de satélite: Formula used when the satellite base does not respond.
I18N.A irradiação vem de base pública; não há: Irradiation comes from a public database; no NBR defines it.
I18N.Plano horizontal. KT de 0,5 é só um exem: Horizontal plane. A KT of 0,5 is only an example.
I18N.NASA POWER (média de longo prazo) guarda: NASA POWER (long-term average) stored on the server (gis.py).
I18N.Potência para cobrir a parte desejada do: Power to cover the desired share of consumption, number of panels and roof area.
I18N.kWp = consumo × cobertura ÷ Σ(H_mês × di: kWp = consumption × coverage ÷ Σ(H_mês × days × PR); panels = ⌈kWp × 1000 ÷ W_placa⌉; area = panels × m²/panel
I18N.O PR inclui temperatura, sujeira, cabos: PR includes temperature, soiling, cables and inverter.
I18N.Citada na tela; a parte elétrica (string: Cited on screen; the electrical part (strings, cables, protections) is not calculated.
Cited; applies to the chosen inverter.
I18N.Usa a irradiação do plano horizontal: em: Uses horizontal-plane irradiation: on a north-facing tilted roof, actual generation is usually higher in winter and lower in summer.
I18N.Consumo do Carbono ou do Início; irradia: Consumption from Carbon or Home; irradiation from the server.
I18N.1) Levar a irradiação para o plano das p: 1) Transpose irradiation to the panel plane (roof tilt and orientation from the Planner; isotropic model). 2) Electrical design per NBR 16690: open-circuit voltage at the site's lowest temperature, string current, DC cable cross-section and protections. Item 1 is software only; item 2 needs an engineer.
I18N.Quanto a energia gerada economiza por an: How much the generated energy saves per year.
I18N.A compensação da energia injetada paga p: Compensation for injected energy pays part of the grid use (Fio B) on a scale that rises year by year; the current calculation ignores this.
I18N.faturamento da micro e minigeração: billing for micro and mini generation
The minimum bill is still charged.
I18N.Superestima a economia de sistemas novos: Overestimates the savings of new systems, especially when almost everything is injected into the grid.
I18N.Separar autoconsumo (vale a tarifa cheia: Separate self-consumption (worth the full tariff) and injected energy (worth the tariff minus that year's Fio B share, per the scale in art. 27 of Lei 14.300: check the percentages in the law); keep the availability cost (minimum by connection type). Needs the fields: self-consumed share, connection type and the Fio B component of the tariff. Software, can be done now.
I18N.Energia da bateria para as horas de auto: Battery energy for the hours of autonomy.
I18N.Não há NBR de dimensionamento de banco d: There is no NBR for sizing battery banks.
I18N.Citada no Planejador para abrigo e segur: Cited in the Planner for enclosure and safety.
I18N.Carga média, sem pico nem perfil por hor: Average load, without peak or hourly profile.
I18N.Unificar com o SustainKit (× 1,2) numa s: Unify with SustainKit (× 1,2) into a single assumption; use the hourly profile when measurements exist.
I18N.Porta da planilha PHYSIS_AVAC-5 (sistema: Port of the PHYSIS_AVAC-5 spreadsheet (sistema/physis-avac.js) and cooling load by room (sistema/physis-cargatermica.js).
I18N.Carga de resfriamento sensível e latente: Sensible and latent cooling load hour by hour (8 h to 18 h) and peak by room and for the whole.
I18N.Q = Σ U·A·ΔT_sol-ar (paredes e cobertura: Q = Σ U·A·ΔT_sol-ar (walls and roofs, with time lag) + glazing (A·FS·I + U·A·ΔT) + people + lighting + equipment + infiltration + outdoor air (1,23·V·ΔT and 3010·V·Δw)
I18N.Caminho de cálculo seguido; as tabelas f: Calculation path followed; the tables were recalled from memory and are marked 'verify'.
I18N.Ordem de grandeza das propriedades dos m: Order of magnitude of material properties.
I18N.Verão, dia 21 do mês; céu claro; perfil: Summer, 21st day of the month; clear sky; profile from 8 to 18 h.
I18N.Tabelas do próprio módulo (DADOS) e equi: The module's own tables (DADOS) and equipment from physis-equipamentos.json.
I18N.Engenheiro confere as tabelas lembradas: An engineer checks the recalled tables (outdoor conditions by city, heat from people, Rp and Ra) against the current standard and removes the 'verify' mark.
I18N.Capacidade de cada ambiente por m² por T: Capacity of each room per m² per TR, rounded to the commercial BTU/h list, and electrical load.
I18N.BTU/h = área ÷ (m²/TR) × 12.000 → próxim: BTU/h = area ÷ (m²/TR) × 12.000 → next commercial size; kWt = TR × 3,517; kWe = kWt ÷ COP
I18N.A norma pede cálculo de carga térmica; a: The standard requires a cooling load calculation; the m²/TR rule is only a screening.
I18N.Triagem da planilha; não substitui a car: Spreadsheet screening; it does not replace the cooling load.
I18N.Quando o ambiente tiver carga térmica ca: When the room has a calculated cooling load, use the result from physis-cargatermica.js instead of the m²/TR rule (software only, can be done now).
I18N.Vazões de banheiros, depósito de lixo, g: Flow rates for bathrooms, garbage rooms, garages and other rooms.
I18N.banheiro = vazão fixa ou área × pé-direi: bathroom = fixed flow or area × ceiling height × air changes/h; garage = greatest of air changes/h, L/s·m² and m³/h per parking space
I18N.Vale para ambientes ocupados; banheiro,: Applies to occupied rooms; bathrooms, garbage rooms and garages follow the building code.
I18N.Exaustão de banheiro, lixo e garagem não: Exhaust for bathrooms, garbage rooms and garages has no NBR for flow rate; values from the spreadsheet (Physis assumption) and from the municipal building code.
I18N.Pôr os valores (90 m³/h por banheiro, tr: Put the values (90 m³/h per bathroom, air changes, L/s·m²) in the assumptions base with their source and check them against the municipal building code.
I18N.Vazão de ar para manter a escada pressur: Air flow to keep the stairwell pressurized and the force needed to open the door.
I18N.Q_vaz = 0,827·A·ΔP^0,5; Q_ab = v·A_porta: Q_vaz = 0,827·A·ΔP^0,5; Q_ab = v·A_porta·n; Q = (Q_vaz + Q_ab) × factor; F = F_fechador + W·A·ΔP ÷ (2·(W − 0,075))
I18N.vazão de projeto e força na porta: design flow rate and door force
I18N.Mesma forma de cálculo; o limite de 110: Same calculation form; the 110 N limit and the ΔP and open-door values come from the spreadsheet.
I18N.Uma escada; sem efeito chaminé nem vento: One stairwell; no stack effect or wind.
I18N.Engenheiro confere na NBR 14880 e na Ins: An engineer checks NBR 14880 and the state Fire Department Technical Instruction: ΔP range, number of open doors, velocity and maximum force. Then put the values in the assumptions base.
I18N.Consumo de água quente, energia, área de: Hot water consumption, energy, collector area, storage tank and backup.
I18N.E = V·4,186·ΔT ÷ 3600; parcela solar = E: E = V·4,186·ΔT ÷ 3600; solar share = E × fraction; area = share ÷ collector production; tank = greater of consumption and area × L/m²
I18N.Segue o roteiro de demanda, fração solar: Follows the demand, solar fraction and volume procedure, with a fixed collector production.
I18N.Produção fixa de 1,8 kWh/m²·dia em qualq: Fixed production of 1,8 kWh/m²·day for any place and month.
I18N.Usar a irradiação mês a mês do lugar (ba: Use the site's month-by-month irradiation (server GIS base, already used in the Solar energy tab) and the collector production from the Inmetro label; size by the worst month or the annual fraction, with tank and piping losses. Software only, with engineer review.
I18N.Perdas por evaporação, convecção, radiaç: Losses from evaporation, convection, radiation and walls; maintenance power and initial heat-up power.
It has no cooling/heating load; only cited.
There is no NBR for pool heat load.
I18N.Regime permanente com médias; sem sol so: Steady state with averages; no sun on the water.

I18N.Contas: densidade ρ = p/(287,05·T) com p: Calculations: density ρ = p/(287.05·T) with p from the standard atmosphere; shear v(h) = v_ref·(h/h_ref)^α; Weibull c = v̄/Γ(1+1/k); energy = 8,760·∫P(v)·f(v)dv; capacity factor = energy/(rated power·8,760). Cp never above Betz (16/27).
I18N.P = ρ·g·Q·H·η (balanço de energia). η é: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η (energy balance). η is for the whole set: turbine × transmission × generator × control; the range in the types table is for the turbine only.
I18N.queda bruta menos a perda de carga da tu: gross head minus the head loss of the penstock. If the pressure was measured at the turbine inlet with the water flowing, the loss is already in the measurement.
I18N.Darcy-Weisbach com o fator de atrito de: Darcy-Weisbach with the Swamee and Jain (1976) friction factor, explicit and valid for turbulent flow (Re from about 5·10³ to 10⁸ and relative roughness from 10⁻⁶ to 10⁻²); below Re 2,000, 64/Re. Between 2,000 and 5,000 (transition) the result is approximate. Hazen-Williams is empirical: only for cold water, turbulent flow and medium and large diameter pipes; it serves as a cross-check.
I18N.ΣK·v²/2g (entrada, curvas, válvulas, gra: ΣK·v²/2g (inlet, bends, valves, trash rack). The K values come from the part's catalogue or from hydraulics tables.
I18N.acima de 3 m/s o sistema avisa; o projet: above 3 m/s the system warns; the design checks the closing surge pressure (Joukowsky, Δh = a·Δv/g, with the pipe's wave speed) and the valve operating time.
I18N.vazão do mês limitada à de projeto (o re: the month's flow is capped at the design flow (the rest goes over the spillway), loss recalculated with the month's flow, constant efficiency (no part-load curve: Kaplan, Pelton and Banki keep their efficiency better with little water than Francis and pump as turbine).
I18N.faixas de queda e vazão de literatura pa: head and flow ranges from the literature for micro and mini plants (ESHA 2004; Paish 2002). The final choice is the manufacturer's, by specific speed.
I18N.analiseInvest da plataforma (o mesmo da: the platform's analiseInvest (the same as in Management), with the year's energy × tariff.
I18N.IEC 61116 — guia do equipamento eletrome: IEC 61116 — guide for electromechanical equipment of small hydroelectric plants; IEC 60041 — field tests to measure turbine efficiency; IEC 60193 — reduced-scale model tests.
I18N.ABNT NBR 12214 — projeto de sistemas de: ABNT NBR 12214 — design of pumping systems for water supply: reference for those using a pump as a turbine and for the supply pipeline.
I18N.Eletrobras — Diretrizes para estudos e p: Eletrobras — Guidelines for studies and designs of small hydro plants (PCH) and Manual of micro hydro plants; ASCE Manual 79 for steel penstocks.
I18N.Uso da água: outorga de direito de uso (: Water use: water use right grant (Law 9.433/1997) from ANA or the state agency, and environmental licence. Plant of up to 5 MW (CGH): exempt from concession or authorization, only notified to ANEEL (Law 9.074/1995, as amended by Law 13.360/2016).
I18N.Conexão à rede como micro ou minigeração: Grid connection as micro or mini generation: Law 14.300/2022 (legal framework and energy compensation), ANEEL REN 1.059/2023 (access, deadlines and billing) and PRODIST Module 3 (access procedures), plus the utility's technical access standard. ABNT NBR 16149:2013 (grid interface) and NBR 16150:2013 (tests of that interface) were written for PV inverters; for a hydro or wind generator, the utility applies the protections of PRODIST and its own standard; grid-certified inverters usually go through the same tests.
I18N.ABNT NBR 5410 (instalações de baixa tens: ABNT NBR 5410 (low-voltage installations) and NBR 5419 (lightning protection); electrical and structural design with ART (technical responsibility record).
I18N.P = ½·ρ·A·v³·Cp, com Cp nunca acima do l: P = ½·ρ·A·v³·Cp, with Cp never above the Betz limit (16/27); zero below cut-in and above cut-out; capped at the rated power. If you have the manufacturer's measured curve, use it: it already includes the rotor, generator and control losses.
I18N.atmosfera padrão (ISO 2533) pela altitud: standard atmosphere (ISO 2533) by altitude and ideal gas by temperature. The manufacturer's curve is given at standard density (1.225 kg/m³); IEC 61400-12-1 normalizes the measurement by density.
I18N.lei de potência v(h) = v_ref·(h/h_ref)^α: power law v(h) = v_ref·(h/h_ref)^α, with α by terrain (Masters 2004) or the α measured between 10 m and 50 m in the open dataset. IEC 61400-1 uses α = 0.2 in the normal design wind profile.
I18N.Weibull com k = 2 (Rayleigh) quando não: Weibull with k = 2 (Rayleigh) when there is no measurement — the same assumption as IEC 61400-12-1 for the reference annual energy; c = v̄/Γ(1 + 1/k).
I18N.8.760 h × ∫P(v)·f(v)dv (integração numér: 8,760 h × ∫P(v)·f(v)dv (numerical integration every 0.05 m/s); with the 12 monthly averages, the sum of the months. Capacity factor = energy ÷ (rated power × 8,760 h).
I18N.abaixo de 4 m/s de média no cubo, pouco: below 4 m/s average at the hub, barely viable; from 4 to 5 m/s, marginal; above that, viable to be confirmed with 12 months of on-site measurement (anemometer at hub height).

I18N.IEC 61400-12-1 — medição da curva de pot: IEC 61400-12-1 — power curve measurement and annual energy calculation; IEC 61400-11 — acoustic noise measurement.

I18N.irradiação global horizontal média de ca: average global horizontal irradiation of each month (NASA POWER, long-term climatology, stored on the server); without the dataset, an estimate from latitude (Duffie and Beckman) with the clearness index. The plane factor corrects for the roof's tilt and orientation (the Planner calculates the exposure of each roof face).
I18N.célula pelo método NOCT, Tc = Ta + (NOCT: cell by the NOCT method, Tc = Ta + (NOCT − 20)/800 · G, with an editable operating G; loss = γ(Pmax) · (Tc − 25 °C). Ta comes from the dataset's monthly average temperature (it includes the night: the value tends to underestimate midday heat; the operating irradiance of 800 W/m² partly compensates).
I18N.sombreamento, sujeira, descasamento, cab: shading, soiling, mismatch, DC cables, inverter (European weighted efficiency) and AC cables, multiplied in cascade. PR = energy delivered ÷ (kWp × irradiation on the plane). The defaults are typical starting values; the project replaces them with its own.
I18N.relação CC/CA usual de 1,10 a 1,35; o co: usual DC/AC ratio of 1.10 to 1.35; peak clipping above that is not included in the monthly calculation.
I18N.Voc na mínima (coeficiente β de Voc) con: Voc at the minimum (Voc β coefficient) against the maximum input voltage; Vmp at the minimum against the top of the window; Vmp at the hottest cell (ambient maximum + NOCT at 1,000 W/m²) against the floor of the window; short-circuit current of the parallel strings against the MPPT current. Vmp uses the same coefficient as Voc (usual approximation; check the Vmp coefficient on the datasheet if there is one).
I18N.geração cai a cada ano pela taxa do módu: generation drops each year by the module's rate; in the payback (analiseInvest, the same as in Management) degradation reduces the tariff increase: (1 + increase)·(1 − degradation) − 1.

I18N.A Taxonomia Sustentável Brasileira (Mini: The Brazilian Sustainable Taxonomy (Ministry of Finance, Ecological Transformation Plan) classifies economic activities that contribute to climate, environmental and social objectives. For an activity to be considered aligned, it must: (1) make a substantial contribution to at least one objective, under the sector's technical criteria; (2) do no significant harm to the other objectives; and (3) meet minimum social and governance safeguards.

I18N.Abordagem por escolha de compra (market-: Market-based approach: energy with a certificate (I-REC) or a contract with origin attributes counts with the contract factor (0 for certified renewable); the rest uses the residual factor. With no residual factor published in Brazil, use the average SIN grid factor and disclose it.

Anyone producing biodiesel from cooking oil or biomethane for sale may consider certification; for own use, the gain appears as an avoided emission.

I18N.Eficiência elétrica no Brasil gera pouco: Electrical efficiency in Brazil generates few credits because the grid already has low emissions; switching from diesel or LPG yields more.
I18N.Emissões da geração da eletricidade comp: Emissions from generating the electricity bought from the grid. The GHG Protocol asks for both figures: location-based (average system factor) and market-based (certificates and contracts).
I18N.Emissões pelo GHG Protocol (padrão corpo: Emissions under the GHG Protocol (corporate standard, scope 2 guidance and scope 3 standard), with the approach of the Brazilian GHG Protocol Program and ISO 14064-1:2018; factors with source and year in the Physis database, those marked “verify” to be checked before official reporting.
I18N.Emissões por grupo de fontes (tCO₂e por: Emissions by source group (tCO₂e per year)
I18N.Emissões que acontecem fora da organizaç: Emissions that happen outside the organisation because of it: purchases, transport, waste, travel, people's commuting and the end of life of what is sold.
I18N.Emissões que saem de fontes da própria o: Emissions from sources owned by the organisation: fuel combustion, refrigerant gas leaks, processes, animals and soil, and waste treated on site.
I18N.Enquadramento no Sistema Brasileiro de C: Classification under the Brazilian Emissions Trading System (SBCE, Lei 15.042/2024) and the potential to generate carbon credits.
I18N.Espécies nativas, plano de manejo e moni: Native species, management plan and monitoring; without replacing existing native vegetation.
I18N.Estrutura da metodologia IGEA (Physis):: Structure of the IGEA methodology (Physis): boundaries and baseline, indicators, management maturity in 13 elements (scale 1 to 5), measures and investment, financing readiness and conclusions.

I18N.Fermentação entérica, manejo de dejetos: Enteric fermentation, manure management and N₂O from manure left on pasture (IPCC factors, Tier 1, Latin America).
I18N.Fim de vida dos produtos vendidos (categ: End of life of sold products (category 12)

I18N.No net zero, corta-se pelo menos 90% das: At net zero, at least 90% of emissions are cut and the rest is neutralised with permanent removals (SBTi Net-Zero Standard, cited by name).
The N in urea (46%) is already included in the calculation.
I18N.O Programa Brasileiro GHG Protocol e o r: The Brazilian GHG Protocol Program and reporting to the UNFCCC use the AR5 100-year GWP in recent cycles; switching to AR6 is under discussion. Check the current guidance of the Program and of the SBCE regulations before reporting.
I18N.O escopo 3 é opcional no Programa Brasil: Scope 3 is optional in the Brazilian GHG Protocol Program, but banks and investors ask for the relevant categories. Tick the ones that apply and explain the ones left out.
I18N.O número é um teto: metano captado e que: The number is a ceiling: methane captured and burned plus the LPG replaced. The real credit depends on the baseline (would the manure go to an open lagoon?) and on biogas metering.
I18N.Ordem de grandeza do estoque de carbono: Order of magnitude of the carbon stock in native vegetation per biome, according to the National Inventory (MCTI, Fourth National Communication) and the literature; the emission from conversion is spread over 20 years (GHG Protocol guidance for the land sector). Highly variable values: use a map of the site in phase 2.
I18N.Os fatores mensais do ano escolhido são: The monthly factors for the chosen year are typed on screen (12 values, tCO2/MWh) from the MCTI table; with them, each month of consumption on Home uses that month's own factor.
I18N.Os limites valem por instalação ou fonte: The thresholds apply per installation or source and look at direct emissions; the law left primary agricultural production out of the obligations. The system's assets are the Brazilian Emission Allowance (CBE) and the Certificate of Verified Emission Reduction or Removal (CRVE).
I18N.Os textos acima resumem as normas com pa: The texts above summarise the standards in Physis's own words; they do not replace reading the documents or third-party verification.

I18N.Clima com 7 meses secos ou mais e sem ir: Climate with 7 or more dry months and no irrigation: the cover of each layer was reduced by 30% so plants do not compete for the little water.
I18N.Agrofloresta em camadas: cada estrato (e: Layered agroforest: each layer (emergent, high, medium, low and ground cover) takes its share of space and light, and the succession phases (placenta I and II, secondary and climax) replace each other over the years. Species were chosen for their functions, their companions and a preference for natives.
I18N.Depois de cada colheita, troque a famíli: After each harvest, change the plant family in the bed (rotation) and, in winter or between seasons, sow green manure.
I18N.Pomar: as frutíferas ocupam cerca de 60%: Orchard: fruit trees cover about 60% of the area with their adult crowns, each at the recommended spacing; a green-manure plant fixes nitrogen and the living cover protects the soil.
I18N.Beira de rio: entram só espécies que tol: Riverbank: only species that tolerate waterlogged soil are used. Under the Forest Code (Lei 12.651/2012, art. 4º, I), the minimum APP strip is 30 m for rivers less than 10 m wide.
I18N.Manutenção: coroamento e controle do cap: Maintenance: weeding around each seedling and grass control for 2 years, ant control, replanting of failures (5–10%). The more species, the better: none should exceed 20% of the seedlings.
I18N.Jardim de chuva: uma depressão de 10 a 2: Rain garden: a 10 to 20 cm depression with draining soil that receives water from the roof or paving and lets it soak in within 48 hours. In the centre, plants that tolerate standing water; at the edge, plants that tolerate flooding and drying. It needs an overflow for heavy rain.
I18N.Faltam espécies de um dos grupos (preenc: Species from one of the groups (filling or diversity) are missing for this site; the 50/50 ratio was not possible.

I18N.Dentro de unidade de conservação é proib: Inside a protected area it is forbidden to introduce non-native species (Lei 9.985/2000, art. 31), with exceptions for APA, National Forest, Extractive Reserve and Sustainable Development Reserve.
I18N.Na zona de amortecimento valem as normas: In the buffer zone, the rules of the management plan apply (Lei 9.985/2000, art. 25). Without a defined zone, licensing near the protected area consults the managing body: 3 km for works with EIA/RIMA and 2 km for the others (Resolução CONAMA 428/2010).
I18N.Na zona de amortecimento, plante nativas: In the buffer zone, plant species native to the biome and avoid exotic ones, especially invasive species and those flagged as possibly invasive.

I18N.Economia = (linha de base − período de r: Savings = (baseline − reporting period) ± adjustments: the general IPMVP equation. The percentage is over the adjusted baseline.
I18N.Ajuste rotineiro: o que muda sempre e se: Routine adjustment: what always changes and can be predicted (production, weather, operating hours). Non-routine adjustment: a one-off change (new area, extra equipment). Use a positive sign when the baseline, under the reporting period conditions, would consume more.

I18N.A incerteza é maior que o efeito: qualqu: The uncertainty is larger than the effect: any result fits inside the error. Either improve the instrument and the installation, or do not promise that percentage.
I18N.Onde instalar medidor, por quanto tempo,: Where to install meters, for how long, and whether the measurement proves what you want to prove. The plan builds itself from the equipment entered in Home.
I18N.Calibração, verificação e ajuste são trê: Calibration, verification and adjustment are three different things.
I18N.Calibrar é comparar contra um padrão ras: Calibrating means comparing against a traceable standard and reporting the error and the uncertainty. Verifying means checking that the error fits your tolerance. Adjusting means changing the instrument. An instrument can be calibrated and still be unfit, if its uncertainty is larger than the effect you want to prove. Demand a certificate from an accredited laboratory, with measured error, uncertainty, standards used and date. And set the interval by risk and drift history, not by habit.

I18N.Contas: água = massa × (u₀ − u)/(100 − u: Calculations: water = mass × (u₀ − u)/(100 − u); heat = water × 2.45 MJ/kg ÷ air use; area = heat ÷ (irradiation × 3.6 × efficiency × days); air = water ÷ Δw, with Δw = 1.006 × ΔT × air use ÷ 2,450; flow = air ÷ 1.15 kg/m³ ÷ hours. Pre-design result: check with the collector and fan suppliers.
I18N.o coletor esquenta o ar, o ventilador em: the collector heats the air, the fan pushes this air through the trays and the air carries away the water from the product. Warmer air holds more water; that is why the inside air is drier than the outside air when the sun is out.
I18N.sempre em base úmida (água ÷ peso total): always on a wet basis (water ÷ total weight). The dry matter does not change during drying, so the weight gives the moisture: u = 100 × (1 − dry matter ÷ weight).
I18N.modelo exponencial simples (de Lewis, ou: simple exponential model (Lewis, or Newton): the weight falls towards an equilibrium weight, ever more slowly. With 3 or more weighings, the screen fits the model to the weights (least squares) and predicts the end time. Without weighings, it uses a typical drying rate for the product (to be verified). Real drying has phases (warm-up, constant rate, falling rate) and day and night; two-phase models (Page, Henderson and Pabis) can be added later, using the dryer's own data.
I18N.café com a massa até 40 °C para qualidad: coffee bean mass up to 40 °C for quality and never above 45 °C (seeds up to 35 °C), stored at 11 to 12 % moisture, following the recommendations of Embrapa Café and the Consórcio Pesquisa Café; medicinal and aromatic herbs between 30 and 40 °C so as not to lose essential oils; sliced fruit between 55 and 65 °C; mushrooms between 40 and 55 °C. All marked "to be verified": the technical team checks them against the product literature and with the buyer.
I18N.balanço de massa (água a tirar), balanço: mass balance (water to remove), energy balance (latent heat of 2.45 MJ per kg of water at about 25 °C) and simplified psychrometrics (the air warms in the collector and cools as it picks up water, with a specific heat of 1.006 kJ/kg·K). The air collector efficiency follows the fundamentals of the ASHRAE Handbook (Fundamentals, psychrometrics) and the ASHRAE 93 standard (testing of solar collectors); the irradiation comes from NASA POWER (long-term average for the site).
I18N.energia que um secador elétrico ou a len: energy that an electric or firewood dryer would use to remove the same water, with the efficiency of each; CO₂ from the Carbon emission factor database (SIN power grid; firewood from IPCC factors, AR5 GWP).
I18N.superaquecimento pelo produto do lote; u: overheating for the batch product; inside humidity above 80 % with the fan off; rain forecast (Open-Meteo, already used on the platform) with the dryer open; device offline. Temperature safety lives in the device itself: it turns the fan on by itself at the limit, even without a network.

I18N.mediana e desvio absoluto mediano (MAD): median and median absolute deviation (MAD) of the vehicle's own samples, with an exponential moving average to follow the trend. It alerts when the robust z (0.6745 × difference ÷ MAD) goes over the threshold; the system states the sample size and only decides after the minimum number of samples.
I18N.o nível do tanque cai além do limite com: the tank level drops beyond the threshold with the vehicle stopped, after subtracting what the flow meter measured.
